'''Anacondans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like [[Species/Legends|species]] that were spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The species were serpentine in shape, had no [[Limb/Legends|arms]] or legs, and used their long tails to grab hold of objects.

Some Anacondans, like [[Cinch]], were adopted as pets.<ref name="videogame">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>

==History==
An [[Unidentified Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] served drinks in [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Another Anacondan, [[Morley/Legends|Morley]], lived on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] until his death at the hands of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
